fn recognizeDigit(rows: []const []const u8, start_col: usize) u8 {

        "   |_|  |", // 4
        " _ |_  _|", // 5
        " _ |_ |_|", // 6
        " _   |  |", // 7
        " _ |_||_|", // 8
        " _ |_| _|", // 9
    };

        if (pattern == d) {
            return '0' + @as(u8, @intCast(idx));
        }
    }
    
    return '?';
}

pub fn convert(buffer: []u8, input: []const []const u8) RecognitionError![]u8 {
    if (input.len % 4 != 0) {
        return RecognitionError.InvalidRowCount;
    }
    
    if (input.len == 0) {
        return RecognitionError.InvalidColumnCount;
    }
    
    const num_cols = input[0].len;

        return RecognitionError.InvalidColumnCount;
    }
    
    for (input) |row| {
        if (row.len != num_cols) {

        }
        
        if (group < num_groups - 1) {
            buffer[buf_idx] = ',';
            buf_idx += 1;
        }
    }
    
    return buffer[0..buf_idx];
